title: Magnetometer Geomagnetic Disturbance Watch
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=magnetometer:reading
| stats avg(delta_nt) as avg_delta_nt, max(delta_nt) as max_delta_nt by sensor
| where avg_delta_nt>50 OR max_delta_nt>100
| sort - max_delta_nt
description: Uses Backyard magnetometer readings telemetry to monitor geomagnetic disturbance against the usual field stability in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for storms or local interference worth correlating with other sensors, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Backyard magnetometer readings data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Sensor table of average and max field delta.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors geomagnetic disturbance against the usual field stability so you can spot storms or local interference worth correlating with other sensors before it becomes annoying.
